research_question: How do different crystal structure featurization methods compare in predicting the formation energy of stable ternary oxide materials from the Materials Project?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are benchmarking crystal-structure featurization methods for machine learning on a ternary-oxide dataset drawn from the Materials Project. Please identify the target property we should train the models to predict, and the elemental constraint that defines this dataset.

phase_2.user_prompt: Following the TER_OX dataset definition in the 2018 matminer paper, please retrieve the required materials data from the Materials Project. We need stable ternary oxides with a unit cell size of at most 30 atoms. Please fetch the structure, number of sites, formation energy per atom, and energy above hull for these materials.
